title: Visiting Researcher Amane Watahiki and Team Director Hitomi Yanaka Receive the JSAI Annual Conference Outstanding Award
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: Amane Watahiki, Visiting Researcher of the Explainable AI Team, and Hitomi Yanaka, Team Director of the Explainable AI Team, have received the 2026 JSAI Annual Conference Outstanding Award from the Japanese Society for Artificial Intelligence (JSAI). This award is presented to research presentations delivered at the JSAI Annual Conference that are recognized as having made outstanding academic or technical contributions, with particular emphasis on originality and usefulness. Recipients are selected by the Annual Conference Award Selection Committee, which is composed of members appointed by the Annual Conference Program Committee. Awarded Research Ontology of Conscious Experience Amane Watahiki, Hitomi Yanaka Award Information Award: 2026 JSAI Annual Conference Outstanding Award (40th Annual Conference) Organization: The Japanese Society for Artificial Intelligence (JSAI) For further information, please visit: https://www.ai-gakkai.or.jp/about/award/jsai_award-conf/ Nihonbashi 1-chome Mitsui Building, 15th floor, e-mail: aip-koho [at]riken.jp *Please replace "[at]" with "@".
